verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules are a fair axis for a game engine and app framework, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack never documents an event, observer or trigger-rule feature. The closest evidence is that ECS systems are 'normal Rust functions', which is a developer building block rather than a user-definable rule-to-action capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
